items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I never worked with him, but I knew he was. Yeah. He was a real good trombone player.

ctx.x: You think Earl was a very good trombone player?

Well, I always thought he was, you know, he was attractive, he could attract your attention. Yeah. Yeah. Who do you think would have been a better trombone player to let you know? At that time, a fellow by the name of... I just might be his nickname. Niece, Zoo Robertson. Yeah. Yeah. He was real... Who you worked with him? I didn't know. I never worked with him, but I knew he was. Yeah. He was a real good trombone player. Uh-huh.
